claims.statement: src/abilities/obs/log.ts writes the JSONL action line — ts (wall-clock ISO, the journey events are date-only) · level · event · actor · runId · taskId/turn · command/phase · REDACTED inputs · outcome · durationMs · error? — at <project>/logs/operation.jsonl; a whole run rebuilds from its runId: `ann log --run <runId>` returns that run's lines in file (happening) order. Pinned by src/abilities/obs/__tests__/log.test.ts (shape + child correlation) and src/e2e/log.e2e.test.ts (a REAL command + its write under one runId, ts non-decreasing).

Wired at the engine's EXISTING chokepoints, never ad hoc: the surface's ONE emit (one line per CLI invocation + outcome — the interactive carve-outs log through the same helper) and one line per HTTP request in service.ts (each under its own request runId); Commands.loggedWrite, ONE wrapper around every mutator (spawn! submit! gate! evidence! capture! complete! append! lock! goal!) so a REFUSED write is as visible as a successful one; Frame.enterPhase/closePhase — the phase spine materialize · gate:grill · activate · execute · verify · gate:confirm · commit · advance, enter + exit with outcome and durationMs; runSemanticDriver — one line per turn (the proposal + the CODE verdict accepted/refused-by-name), the boundary draft, and one stop line with the route reason. The provider calls stay in the op-log, which now carries the SAME runId (the two files join on --run) — no payload duplicated. Pinned by src/flow/__tests__/frame.test.ts (the phase spine, entry/exit in order with durations) and src/flow/__tests__/semantic-driver.test.ts (turns, a forbidden-call refusal, the boundary draft, the stop reason).

All four invariants are enforced in code and each has its own test: (1) NEVER throws into the flow — OpLog.line catches every failure and warns on stderr; proven with logs/ as a FILE (unit: no throw + the warn; e2e: `ann status` still exits 0 with its normal stdout); (2) REDACTION per NFR-SEC-1 — a value under a secret-looking key is dropped, a value matching a known secret (env-derived) is dropped, a prompt/completion is {chars, sha} (never verbatim), long strings truncated; proven with a planted secret riding BOTH the env and the argv — absent from the file; (3) BOUNDED — writeLine rotates at 4 MiB to operation.jsonl.1 (one generation: 2x cap on disk, max), the live file held under the cap (tested with a small cap over 40 writes); (4) SCRATCH, never the record — <project>/logs/operation.jsonl, gitignored, and the scratch home ignores ITSELF (logs/.gitignore = '*', so a `git add -A` cannot sweep it into a project's record — the e2e asserts the fixture stays clean and the journey events are untouched).

`ann log [--task <id>] [--run <runId>] [--level info|warn|error] [--since <iso|30m|2h|1d>] [--tail <n>]` is a derived, total read over the log file (readOpLog: both generations, oldest first, unparseable lines counted — a missing file is an empty page, never a crash), value-canonical (JSON = the text render), exposed in the command table + README; and GET /api/log serves the SAME handler over the service (`?task=&run=&level=&since=&tail=`, a bad filter is the CLI's own usage error over HTTP 400). Pinned by the unit read tests and src/e2e/log.e2e.test.ts (filters by run/task/level/since/tail, the usage errors, the route).
